setup.intro: Day 12 of the outbreak. Your group has barricaded itself inside a suburban shopping mall. The food court is running low, and nobody trusts the escalators.

roles.title: The Self-Appointed Leader
roles.blurb: Wrote a whiteboard of rules on day one. Nobody voted for this.

roles.title: The Medic (Watched Grey's Anatomy Once)
roles.blurb: Very confident. Holds the only first-aid kit.

roles.title: The Scavenger
roles.blurb: Knows where everything is in the mall and isn't telling.

roles.title: The Morale Officer
roles.blurb: Keeps spirits up with snacks and increasingly unhinged pep talks.

roles.title: The Suspiciously Calm One
roles.blurb: Hasn't panicked once. That's the problem.

relationships: {a} saved {b} from a zombie on day 3 and brings it up constantly.
{a} thinks {b} was bitten and is hiding it.
{a} and {b} share a night watch shift and have a secret handshake.
{a} owes {b} a favour, and {b} has not forgotten.
{a} is convinced {b} would leave the group behind first.

choice.scene: A voice on the radio promises safety at an army base 40 km away. The catch: you'd have to leave the mall tonight.
options: Stay. The mall has a Cinnabon.
Answer the radio with a fake name

choice.scene: A stranger knocks on the barricade holding a full bag of groceries. They say they're 'definitely not bitten.'
options: Take the groceries, not the stranger

choice.scene: The power flickers. Someone has to go down to the basement generator. Alone. In the dark.
options: Give a long speech until someone else volunteers

vote_player.scene: The last can of peaches sits on the food court table. Everyone saw it. Nobody has touched it... yet.
vote_player.prompt: Who would secretly eat the last can of peaches tonight?

vote_player.scene: A horde is heading for the mall. The escape van has room for everyone, but somebody is going to slow things down.
vote_player.prompt: Who is most likely to get the group caught because of something ridiculous?

vote_player.scene: Rescue finally arrives. The soldier asks who was in charge of your group.
vote_player.prompt: Who would claim to be the leader, whether or not it's true?

predict.scene: {target} finds a working shower in the gym. First hot water in 12 days. The horde is 10 minutes away.
options: Tells everyone and makes a rota
Guards the door with a mop

predict.scene: A rival survivor group with much better food offers {target} a spot. Only {target}.
{target} can take one luxury item on the escape van.

titles: Most Likely to Befriend a Zombie
Would Survive Out of Pure Spite
recap.epilogue: You made it out of the mall. The group chat will never be the same.
